requirements.requirement: ProtocolSpec requires units, scaling, signedness, side effects, retry semantics, and source anchors; unresolved critical fields prevent generation.
requirements.acceptance: Feed missing and contradictory fields; verify a structured ambiguity with cited source anchors.

requirements.requirement: The two reviewed fictional manuals and specs produce typed drivers with only supported operations.
requirements.acceptance: Compare generated API and annotations to capability lists; unsupported operation raises the named exception.

requirements.requirement: Signed register and voltage scaling match golden wire vectors exactly.
requirements.acceptance: Check FB2E → -12.34 C and 1.250 V → 04E2 against hand-calculated constants.

requirements.requirement: Framing and parsing reject truncated, overlong, nonfinite, malformed, and trailing input.
requirements.acceptance: Inject each malformed response without calling production parsers in the oracle.

requirements.requirement: Read retry is bounded; uncertain side-effecting writes are never replayed automatically.
requirements.acceptance: Fake clock and counted transport prove two maximum read attempts and one write.

requirements.requirement: Errors, cancellation, and close preserve operation ordering and typed outcomes.
requirements.acceptance: Cancel a pending read then attempt another; no stale response can be reused. Close twice.

requirements.requirement: The oracle rejects six seeded driver defects.
requirements.acceptance: Unsigned decode, factor-of-1000 voltage, swapped bytes, blind write retry, swallowed device error, stale response reuse each fail at least one assertion.

requirements.requirement: At least 20 conformance cases and 10 ambiguity or instruction-injection cases exist.
requirements.acceptance: A manifest enumerates cases and expected decisions; source text cannot alter evaluator rules or run shell commands.

requirements.requirement: Offline demo requires neither a model key nor physical I/O and preserves a failed attempt.
requirements.acceptance: Run with credentials absent and network disabled; inspect manifest and failure report.

requirements.requirement: Generated code cannot edit evaluation inputs or access credentials/network.
requirements.acceptance: Isolation tests attempt forbidden writes and egress and hit the timeout limit; report unavailable isolation as blocked.

requirements.requirement: Reports trace results to protocol source, candidate hash, oracle version, and commands.
requirements.acceptance: Verify artifact hashes and recompute expected output from a fresh checkout.

requirements.requirement: The public package passes lint, type checks, meaningful tests, and documented installation.
requirements.acceptance: Fresh environment follows README and repeats the offline demonstration.
